arxiv-2401-01889.title: Bridging relativistic jets from black hole scales to long-term electromagnetic radiation distances: A moving-mesh general relativistic hydrodynamics code with the HLLC Riemann solver
arxiv-2401-01889.creator: Xiaoyi Xie ID, Alan Tsz-Lok Lam ID
arxiv-2401-01889.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyi Xie ID, Alan Tsz-Lok Lam ID. Relativistic jets accompany the collapse of massive stars, the merger of compact objects, or the accretion of gas in active galactic nuclei. They carry information about the central engine and generate electromagnetic radiation. No self-consistent simulations have been able to follow these jets from their birth at the black hole scale to the Newtonian dissipation phase, making the inference of central engine property through astronomical observations undetermined.

arxiv-2401-12997.title: Progressive Distillation Based on Masked Generation Feature Method for Knowledge Graph Completion
arxiv-2401-12997.creator: Cunhang Fan, Yujie Chen, Jun Xue, Yonghui Kong, Jianhua Tao, Zhao Lv
arxiv-2401-12997.description: Abstract In recent years, knowledge graph completion (KGC) models based on pre-trained language model (PLM) have shown promising results. However, the large number of parameters and high computational cost of PLM models pose challenges for their application in downstream tasks.

arxiv-2405-12500.title: Entropic associative memory for real world images
arxiv-2405-12500.creator: Noé Hernández
arxiv-2405-12500.description: Abstract Abstract The entropic associative memory (EAM) is a computational model of natural memory incorporating some of its putative properties of being associative, distributed, declarative, abstractive and constructive. Previous experiments satisfactorily tested the model on structured, homogeneous and conventional data: images of manuscripts digits and letters, images of clothing, and phone representations.

arxiv-2409-04842.title: Reinforcement Learning for Rate Maximization in IRS-aided OWC Networks
arxiv-2409-04842.creator: Ahrar N. Hamad, Ahmad Adnan Qidan, Taisir E.H. El-Gorashi and Jaafar M. H. Elmirghani
arxiv-2409-04842.description: Abstract Optical wireless communication (OWC) is envisioned as one of the main enabling technologies of 6G networks, complementing radio frequency (RF) systems to provide high data rates. One of the crucial issues in indoor OWC is service interruptions due to blockages that obstruct the line of sight (LoS) between users and their access points (APs).

arxiv-2410-15064.title: A Prompt Engineering Approach and a Knowledge Graph based Framework for Tackling Legal Implications of Large Language Model Answers
arxiv-2410-15064.creator: George Hannah, Rita T. Sousa, Ioannis Dasoulas, Claudia d’Amato
arxiv-2410-15064.description: Abstract With the recent surge in popularity of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is the rising risk of users blindly trusting the information in the response, even in cases where the LLM recommends actions that have potential legal implications and this may put the user in danger.

arxiv-2411-09662.title: On the Ferrimagnetic State of CrCl 2 (pyz) 2
arxiv-2411-09662.creator: Freja Schou Guttesen, Per Hedegård
arxiv-2411-09662.description: Abstract Van der Waals layered ferromagnetic compounds with high two-dimensional electronic conductivity holds strong potential for quantum computing, future unconventional superconductors, catalysts, batteries, and fuel cells. We suggest a minimal theoretical model to understand the magnetic properties of the metal-organic framework CrCl 2 (pyz) 2 (pyz=pyrazine).

pmc-10738427.title: DO DEPRESSIVE SYMPTOMS MEDIATE SEGREGATION’S IMPACT ON COGNITIVE AGING IN OLDER MEXICAN AMERICANS?
pmc-10738427.creator: Emily Morris, Jeremy Grant, Alexandra Clark, Darlingtina Esiaka, Kristine Ajrouch, Wassim Tarraf
pmc-10738427.description: Segregation in the United States has important implications for cognitive aging among Mexican Americans as a social determinant of health. Because segregation is systemically engrained, identifying more immediately modifiable mechanisms, such as depressive symptoms, that may underly segregation-cognition associations could point to intervention targets to reduce cognitive aging disparities.

pmc-11331410.title: Discrete measurements of RNA polymerase and reverse transcriptase fidelity reveal evolutionary tuning
pmc-11331410.creator: Vladimir Potapov, Stanislas Krudup, Sean Maguire, Irem Unlu, Shengxi Guan, Jackson A Buss, Benedict A Smail, Trevor van Eeuwen, Martin S Taylor, Kathleen H Burns, Jennifer L Ong, Robert J Trachman
pmc-11331410.description: Direct methods for determining the fidelity of DNA polymerases are robust, with relatively little sample manipulation before sequencing. In contrast, methods for measuring RNA polymerase and reverse transcriptase fidelities are complicated by additional preparation steps that introduce ambiguity and error.

pmc-11371645.title: Bacteria modulate microalgal aging physiology through the induction of extracellular vesicle production to remove harmful metabolites
pmc-11371645.creator: Yun Deng, Ruyi Yu, Veit Grabe, Thomas Sommermann, Markus Werner, Marine Vallet, Christian Zerfaß, Oliver Werz, Georg Pohnert
pmc-11371645.description: The bloom and bust patterns of microalgae in aquatic systems contribute massively to global biogeochemical cycles. The decline of algal blooms is mainly caused by nutrient limitation resulting in cell death, the arrest of cell division and the aging of surviving cells. Nutrient intake can re-initiate proliferation, but the processes involved are poorly understood.

pmc-11527828.title: Targeting the DNA damage response in cancer
pmc-11527828.creator: Guffanti Federica, Chiappa Michela, Damia Giovanna
pmc-11527828.description: DNA damage response (DDR) pathway is the coordinated cellular network dealing with the identification, signaling, and repair of DNA damage. It tightly regulates cell cycle progression and promotes DNA repair to minimize DNA damage to daughter cells. Key proteins involved in DDR are frequently mutated/inactivated in human cancers and promote genomic instability, a recognized hallmark of cancer.

pmc-11691820.title: CAREGIVING FOR OLDER ADULTS LIVING WITH DEMENTIA AND CONCURRENT HEARING LOSS
pmc-11691820.creator: Charity Lewis, Wuyang Zhang, Nicholas Reed, Victoria Sanchez, Michelle Arnold, William Haley
pmc-11691820.description: While hearing loss and dementia are highly concurrent conditions, there is a lack of studies examining its impact on dementia caregiving. Hearing loss has been identified as an unmet need among older adults living with dementia, as it contributes to communication challenges.

pmc-11714499.title: A longitudinal real‐world study in patients with Alzheimer’s Disease dementia using frequent multi‐domain digital measurements at‐home performed on the Cumulus NeuLogiqTM Platform: usability and feasibility findings
pmc-11714499.creator: Shannon Diggin, Azar Alexander‐Sefre, Brian Murphy, Hugh Nolan, James B Rowe, Laura M Rueda‐Delgado, Alison R Buick
pmc-11714499.description: BackgroundMany outcome measures used in AD clinical trials require clinic visits and are paper based, making them infrequent and burdensome ‘snapshots’, subject to rater bias. A consortium of 10 pharma companies came together with Cumulus Neuroscience to design a solution for frequent, objective, real‐world measurement across a range of domains.

pmc-12421066.title: Acute Post‐Streptococcal Glomerulonephritis in a 22‐Month‐Old Toddler: A Rare and Uncustomary Age of Onset
pmc-12421066.creator: Abrham Bire Akeberegn, Amanuel Anegagregn Bizuneh
pmc-12421066.description: Acute post‐streptococcal glomerulonephritis (APSGN) is an important immunological complication that follows Group A Streptococcus (GAS) infections. It usually affects children between 5 and 15 years of age and is rarely seen in children younger than 3 years, likely because their immature immune systems limit the exaggerated immune response. The condition typically presents with hematuria, edema, hypertension, and renal insufficiency.

pmc-13254902.title: Single-granule profiling reveals that RNP granule pH marks cellular translation
pmc-13254902.creator: Yue Zhang, Shining Wu, Yifeng He, Xuhan Xia, Jinchao Wei, Shijia Wu, Ruijie Deng
pmc-13254902.description: SummaryRibonucleoprotein (RNP) granules reshape RNA metabolism in eukaryotic cells, yet their biophysical properties remain poorly understood due to the lack of probes targeting these small, dynamic condensates. Herein, we developed RNP granule-pH (RNPg-pH), a ratiometric and targetable probe, to map the pH of processing bodies (P-bodies) and stress granules (SGs) at the single-granule level.

pmc-13477693.title: Comparative Study of Plasma Electrolyte Status in Pre-eclamptic and Normotensive Pregnant Women in Zaria
pmc-13477693.creator: A.K Ogunkunle, F.A Mahmud, M.G Abubakar, A.B Dogara, F.A. Mahmud, F.A. Musa, A IbnUthman, I. Modu, M. Manu, H.M. Suleiman
pmc-13477693.description: Background:Pre-eclampsia is a major cause of maternal and perinatal morbidity, characterized by endothelial dysfunction and renal impairment that may alter electrolyte balance. However, findings on electrolyte disturbances remain inconsistent, and the absence of population-specific reference intervals limits clinical interpretation in low-resource settings.

pmc-13480044.title: The association between vitamin D and hypothyroidism: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13480044.creator: Xiaopeng Sun, Changgui Kou, Yuan Feng, Xijie He, Xiangrui Song, Qianlu Ding, Qianlong Huang, Qianyi Wang, Yong Shen, Wei Bai

pmc-13560100.title: The IPTA Nashville Consensus Conference on Post‐Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disorders After Solid Organ Transplantation in Children: Updates on Classification and Prevention—2026
pmc-13560100.creator: Michael Green, Marian G Michaels, Thomas Gross, Upton Allen, Catherine M Bollard, Olivia Martinez, Masaki Yamada, Steven H Swerdlow
pmc-13560100.description: The 2019 International Pediatric Transplant Association (IPTA) consensus conference assessed available evidence and developed recommendations for various aspects of care relating to post‐transplant lymphoproliferative disorders (PTLD) after solid organ transplantation in children. Because of the key role Epstein‐Barr Virus (EBV) plays in the pathogenesis of many PTLD cases, it was addressed in many recommendations from the Consensus Conference.

pmc-13609579.title: Development and Immunogenicity Evaluation of Baculovirus-Expressed Feline Bocavirus VP2 Virus-like Particles Vaccine in a Mouse Model
pmc-13609579.creator: Jia-You Xing, Zi-Xuan Fu, Wen-Jie Xu, Jing-Yang Li, Zi-Ji Wang, Yu-Xin Xiang, Jiang Wang, Sheng-Li Ming, Yue-Ting Zheng, Jian-Li Li, Lei Zeng
pmc-13609579.description: Feline bocavirus (FBoV) is an emerging enteric virus associated with gastrointestinal diseases in cats and has attracted increasing attention in feline health. However, no commercial vaccine is currently available for the prevention and control of FBoV infection. VP2 is the major capsid protein of FBoV and represents a promising target for vaccine development.

pmc-13649391.creator: Yuling Yang, Junbiao Chen, Zhicheng Lin, Lisha Yi, Nanye Zhu, Jiangquan Hong, Yimin Lin, Jiabin Li
